name: Threadleaf groundsel
desc: Threadleaf groundsel (Senecio flaccidus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Senecio flaccidus, also known as threadleaf ragwort, is a member of the daisy family. It is native from central to southwest North America, where it is common in gravelly and dry areas.
